subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.9 QQBot: long markdown reply is split into N independent bubbles (one per chunk), not a single message

question: Should QQBot keep splitting every long markdown chunk as the supported by-design behavior, or accept the bounded safe-size merge policy proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99032?
rationale: Current source and tests preserve per-chunk sends, a member comment says that behavior is intentional for QQ markdown safety, and the open PR changes user-visible delivery batching with proof; automation cannot choose that product tradeoff.

options.title: Decide through the bounded merge PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99032 as the review vehicle because it preserves overflow splitting while merging only chunks that fit the existing safe byte limit.

options.title: Close as by design
options.body: Keep the current multi-message split policy and close this issue plus candidate merge PRs if QQ markdown truncation risk outweighs one-bubble coherence.

options.title: Request more live QQ proof
options.body: Ask for live overflow and very large table/code proof before choosing between the split policy and bounded safe-size merge policy.

recommendation.title: Decide through the bounded merge PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99032 as the review vehicle because it preserves overflow splitting while merging only chunks that fit the existing safe byte limit.

likelyOwner.reason: sliverp authored the core QQBot markdown chunking behavior, gave the by-design comment, and is assigned to the linked candidate PR.
